newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Key Hungary shares trade in narrow range, BUX firms.
newsitem.headline: Key Hungary shares trade in narrow range, BUX firms.

text.p: Leading Hungarian share traded in narrow ranges on the Budapest Stock Exchange as the market sought new information to trade on, traders said.
On Friday the BUX index ended at 3,614.20 points, up 12.21.
The index continued to advance and was seen going further up but traders said a strong rise would need fresh news.
"The BUX index rose modestly and it seems that new information is needed for the market to rise substantially," said Robert Forgo of MKB Securities.
"Third quarter company earnings could influence the rise while the international environment is quite positive," Forgo said.
In addition to domestic corporate news, the U.S's Federal Open Market Committee meeting later this month may have an influence on Hungarian share prices, traders said.
On Friday chemical company Borsodchem rose 65 forints, or two percent, to finish at 3,205 forints on expectations of strong third-quarter results.

Oil company MOL remained steady at 1,585 forints and traders said its price movements in the near future will be determined by the size of yet-to-be-announced energy price rise rather than by MOL's interim results.
